mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Fireman Park with a temperature of 59 degrees and a Waxing Gibbous moon phase. The ISS is passing overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has announced that crack filling maintenance will begin on September 28 across several areas including Nine Mound Road and Commerce Parkway, which may cause minor traffic delays. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to review several development projects, such as site plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can check out trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, and don't forget the downtown Farmer's Market happening on September 23.

Looking at the latest police report, on September 5, officers responded to a peculiar incident where multiple vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields, which was linked to a social media prank.
While we usually look forward to the daily flavor, please be advised that the Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a remodeling project.
